text:
alex: Heads up — ACME asked to push tenant routing + full SSO into v1. They flagged it as a contract blocker, asked for a June timeline. Thoughts?
maya: Oof. What does "full SSO" mean here? OIDC + SCIM + audit exports?
alex: Their note: OIDC, SCIM for user provisioning, plus audit log export to their SIEM. They want GA-ish behavior by mid-June.
simon: Mid-June is pretty tight. Our current plan treats SSO as MVP+1.
emily: If we accelerate, something else has to slide. Any proposals for what to cut?
alex: Account team says analytics retention and promo dashboard are lower priority for the customer.
maya: Quick breakdown (rough): auth dev 6w (if we build SCIM), infra 2w (VPC/KMS certs), QA/compliance 2w. So ~10w end-to-end.
sam: Add time for legal SLA negotiation — estimate ~1–2w parallel but often blocking.
nora: Our public milestone for v1 is July; June 15 could be a canary, not GA. Could we offer a canary that meets their needs?
maya: Option: Scoped canary = OIDC + audit logs (no SCIM) on June 15. Full SCIM + GA in v1 (mid-July).
simon: Technically feasible if we scope SCIM out. SCIM is the biggest integration surface and testing burden.
emily: Operationally, audit logs + export hooks are lower lift than SCIM. We can wire export to S3/Kinesis and push to SIEM connectors.
alex: I asked the customer if OIDC-only + audit logs + an SLA buffer is acceptable. They said they'd consider an OIDC-first path if we provide audit exports and a firm GA date for SCIM.
simon: Then our negotiation play: deliver OIDC-canary (June 15), commit to SCIM GA in v1 (July 15), and provide audit exports + preliminary SLA.
maya: Work estimate if scoped:
- OIDC integration (3w)
- audit exports/retention (1w)
- infra prep (VPC/KMS) (2w)
- QA/compliance (2w)
= ~8w total (with parallelization can be tightened to ~6w)
emily: Even 6w requires reassigning two engineers from analytics/promo. That means the promo dashboard and longer retention can move to v1.1.
alex: Tradeoffs look reasonable. We should document a formal decision and list the cuts.
jira-bot: Created TICKET-4234 SSO-canary-scope with checklist — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/TICKET-4234
maya: Proposal for decision doc: acceptance criteria for canary (OIDC working for 3 pilot orgs, audit export validated, feature flag gating), rollback plan, infra runbook, SLAs we can commit to. I'll draft PRD.
simon: Infra note: we can run canary in eu-west region to reduce blast radius. Need a short-lived route and autoscale config.
emily: I'll draft runbook and rollback steps. Also add metrics to monitor: auth failures, latencies, KV cache hit rate, and export throughput.
alex: Action items: maya -> PRD by EOD, simon -> infra plan + canary routing by Fri, emily -> runbook + metrics by Fri, sam -> flag legal about SLA options. I'll confirm OIDC-acceptance with customer today.
maya: ack :thumbsup:
emily: ack
simon: ack
alfred (account): FYI I flagged this with ACME; they asked for weekly checkpoints. I'll schedule.
nora: Decision summary (to capture here): OIDC-canary targeted for Jun 15 (feature-flagged, 3 pilot orgs), full SCIM + GA targeted for Jul 15 as part of v1. Cuts: promo dashboard and extended analytics retention -> v1.1. Risks: SLA negotiation, SCIM testing surface.
alex: thanks — I'll update the account and customers. Closing loop once they confirm the scoped canary.
